Raised in a home where his parents led the reggae outfit Chakula, an environment where music felt less like a dream and more like daily language he entered the studio early, recording his first track, Mix A Color, at just five years old. Sonically, Keznamdi stands at the intersection of tradition and now: threading roots reggae and dancehall with global influences, including Bongo Flava, R&B, and rap, delivered with a writers intention and a performers warmth.
